data.title: Tom Lee Says AI Sell-Off Is ‘Max Pain’ Before A ‘Big Payoff’ For Patient Investors
data.description: During an interview with CNBC, Lee pointed to historical parallels, continued infrastructure demand and the economic importance of data centers as reasons investors shouldn't abandon the trade just yet.
